title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
title_zh: FinEvo：面向长程金融建模的递归自我改进
abstract_en: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in professional domains. Code is available at https://github.com/pcj-sudo/FinEvo.
abstract_zh: FinEvo 探索金融建模与大语言模型（LLM）自我改进能否相互促进。该框架用同一个模型构建金融模型，通过自博弈（self-play）迭代生成更具挑战性的任务，再利用可执行奖励（executable rewards）从求解经历中学习。基于 Qwen3.6-27B 的端到端实验表明，求解反馈既能推动任务提高推理要求，也能发现可执行检查遗漏的任务规格问题。训练后，同源留出任务的整题成功率从 22.73% 提升至 29.09%，SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial 上则从 13.13% 提升至 19.19%。不同任务来源与评估设置下均观察到相近的增益，训练中未出现的任务类别也有所改善，表明该框架可能增强了可跨任务迁移的金融建模能力。
key_points_zh: 同一个 Qwen3.6-27B 贯穿金融模型构建、挑战迭代和经验学习。
求解反馈不仅能提高任务的推理要求，还能发现可执行检查未覆盖的任务规格问题。
整题成功率在同源留出任务和 SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial 上分别提高 6.36 和 6.06 个百分点。
未见任务类别上的提升为能力迁移提供了初步证据。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是让同一模型通过自博弈迭代生成电子表格建模挑战，再用求解交互和可执行奖励更新策略；两个留出评测均报告了整任务成功率提升。可借鉴的设计是用求解反馈调整挑战，而不只依赖可执行检查。摘要未证明生成、筛选或验证后续改进的机制本身得到提升，因此不标记 RSI。
